menu.$description: Dropdown action menu (Radix's 'DropdownMenu') — a list of things you *do* (Rename, Duplicate, Delete), not a list of selectable options with persistent state (that's Listbox, a separate component — the ARIA role and keyboard model genuinely differ: menu/menuitem vs. listbox/option). Built on Popover's same shell: native `popover` attribute (top-layer, outside-click/Escape dismissal for free), border.default + shadow.sm + radius.default, the same small positioning script. This project doesn't implement real arrow-key/type-ahead keyboard navigation or ARIA roles (a static tokens+docs generator, not a live component library) — noted here so nobody mistakes the visual-only demo for a complete accessible implementation; a real port needs roving tabindex and role=menu/menuitem added on top of these tokens.

itemRadius.$description: 4px — concentric with the panel's own 8px radius minus the 4px outer padding (the same inner=outer-padding rule learned building Tabs' pill-in-track), so an item sitting in the top corner curves smoothly with the panel instead of fighting it.

padding.$description: 4px outer padding around the whole item list.

gap.$description: 2px between items — same as Popover's own menu example.

itemGap.$description: 8px between an item's icon and its label — same flat gap Button uses.

hoverBg.$description: Pale red tint (the same passive-surface role Card/badges would use), not fill.neutralHover — a destructive item's hover should read as 'still red', not revert to neutral gray.
